item.title: Jaishankar Urges Counter-Terrorism Action at US Event in Mumbai
item.description: S. Jaishankar emphasized the need for zero tolerance toward terrorism during an American Independence Day event in Mumbai, following discussions with visiting US official Marco Rubio.

item.title: Madurai Children Participate in Traditional Vidyarambam Ceremonies
item.description: Numerous young children in Madurai have commenced their formal education by taking part in traditional Vidyarambam initiation rituals.
